name: format_summary_section
representative_why: Users need summary areas to be visually distinguishable, readable, and stable for review or print workflows.
representative_how: apply consistent headings, totals, labels, and spacing around summary ranges
separate calculated summary regions from editable input areas
concrete_workflows: prepare invoice totals, budget summaries, or dashboard summary blocks for review
verification_strategy: Promote only when formatting expectations are represented as bounded workbook assertions rather than subjective layout preference.
notes: Tracked as advisory because current runtime support focuses on data correctness and protection, not general layout formatting.
